notes.title: HandyGames 25th Anniversary + Oddsparks 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
HandyGames turned 25 this year! To celebrate we are offering amazing discounts on some of our all-time fan favorites.

On top of that, we are transitioning our newest game Oddsparks from Early Access to its 1.0 version with loads of new content and improvements - so there is not better time to get it than now!

What are you waiting for? Go to the event and check out our offers!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.17.19
notes.notes: Fixed a crash related to Windows 11

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 11
notes.notes:
- Improved signposting by adding some tutorials and hints
- Corrected some minor localization and other text errors
- Ironed out UI information given to the player
- Fixed softlocks related to jumping in or out of bushes
- Several other bug fixes

notes.title: Update notes for Aug 30
notes.notes:
Fixed cubs getting stuck inside the River & Forest lairs on night 28.
 Fixed a crash when learning the cub skill hunt on night 29
 Prevented Dumping Site shortcut from being locked forever.
 Fixed cubs sometimes ignoring their food.
 Fixed getting trapped by guards in Care Corp.
 Tweaked tutorials so that they are not missed that easily.
 More minor bugfixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Endling has a Release Date!
notes.notes:
Thank you, everyone, for your excited patience and all the motivating feedback we have gotten from you so far. It's finally time to reveal the official release date of Endling - Extinction is Forever. Starting July 19th, you'll be able to jump into this project that is so very near and dear to our hearts. We can't wait to read your reviews, watch your streams and videos, laugh at your memes, and share with you this devastating, yet beautiful world that the talented and dedicated people of Herobeat Studios have created.

Watch the new trailer below and make sure to join us later today on Twitch!
We'll be showing you new gameplay, talking about Endling, and answering any questions you might have starting 7 PM CEST / 1 PM Eastern / 10 AM Pacific. And if you're lucky, you might even get a free game key that will unlock Endling as soon as it is released right here on Steam ;)

http://www.twitch.tv/handygames_official
